description: the negative control of codegen/gen-schema-check-version-blind: a Cargo.toml [package] version is ignored only while it equals the generator version the manifest records, so a hand-edited version matching neither that version nor the running generator's is KDLITH-GEN002 changed and exits 1, both against a manifest naming the running generator and against one naming an earlier version

command: sed -i '0,/^version = "[^"]*"$/s//version = "0.0.8"/' out/Cargo.toml && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check; echo "exit=$?"

sed -i 's/^#@ generator kdlith version="[^"]*"$/#@ generator kdlith version="0.0.9"/' out/kdlith-manifest && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check; echo "exit=$?"
